check.label: Packing: how each piece is checked
check.help: Before an order can be marked packed, every piece is checked against the order. "Scan": the packer scans each piece's barcode and the SKU must match a line of the order (a wrong piece is refused). "Type the SKU": when the scanner is off, the packer may type the SKU instead. "Tick": no scanner at all; the packer ticks each line by hand.

photo.label: Packing proof photo
photo.help: A photo of the open parcel before it is closed, to settle a "wrong item" or "missing piece" complaint. Off until you turn it on. "Required": an order cannot be marked packed or booked with the courier until it has the photos; the owner (or a role he gives the right) can let one order go without it, with a reason. "Reminder": the screen asks for it, nothing waits. "Photos": how many each parcel needs. "Days to keep": after this many days a photo is archived (kept in the media library, not shown on the order).

weight.label: Packing: weigh the parcel
weight.help: The packer types the scale reading and the shop compares it with the pieces' own weights (from each product's weight). Off until you turn it on. A reading that is off by more than both "percent" and "grams" is flagged: the packer weighs again or confirms it is right. "Reading needed": an order cannot be marked packed without a reading. A piece without a weight is never guessed: then nothing is compared.

queue.label: Packing screen: lists
queue.help: "Days on Handed over": how many days an order stays on the last step after it was handed over (0: today only). "Orders per step": the most orders one step lists, oldest first.
